name: PDBFixer
summary: Prepare biomolecular structures by finding and repairing common PDB-file issues before simulation.

argv: from pdbfixer import PDBFixer; assert PDBFixer

notes: PDBFixer 1.12 is a noarch conda package but depends on platform-specific OpenMM. The reviewed architectures follow available OpenMM builds; dependency solving has not been tested on every platform.
PDB repair may change atoms, protonation, or missing regions; preserve the original structure and review the output before simulation.
